definitions.gloss: mesh; net openings; holes in a net
definitions.explanation: the individual openings in a net or woven material
a pattern resembling a network of crossed lines

notes:
{網目|あみめ} refers to the openings in a net or mesh, or to patterns resembling such a structure.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (net) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye/opening) = the 'eyes' or holes of a net.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {網目|あみめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧/⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧ (fine/coarse mesh)
- {網目|あみめ}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (mesh-like, reticulated)
- {網目|あみめ}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧ (mesh/net pattern)

USAGE:
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{網目|あみめ} (loopholes in the law)
- {網目|あみめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる (to slip through the net/evade)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (net)
- メッシュ (mesh - loanword)
- {格子|こうし} (lattice)
- ⟦{編|あ}み{目|め}→編み目：28972_amime⟧ (stitch in knitting - different word)

NOTE: Don't confuse with ⟦{編|あ}み{目|め}→編み目：28972_amime⟧ (knitting stitch), which uses a different kanji.
